Yes, actually, I am aware that it is overdue by about 10 days now. There was a medical emergency in my family, so my account had insufficient funds at that time. But now I have arranged the funds and I am going to pay the full EMI today itself. 

However, I saw that a late penalty has been added to my account. Given my family circumstances, I would like to request a one-time penalty waiver on this. Kindly do the needful. If you cannot approve this directly, could you please escalate this to someone who has the authority to waive it?
